card.name: Verbs before 'damaged' in package checks
card.fires_on: The linking word just before 'damaged' or similar in package-integrity warnings, mostly 'been' after 'has' or 'has not'. Also fires on words like 'products' or 'first' in inspection and first-use instructions.

modes.label: Package damage check
modes.description: 'been' or 'appears' right before 'damaged' in do-not-use-if-damaged warnings.
modes.example: Do not use if package has<< been>> damaged. 2. Remove the plastic

modes.label: Inspect before use
modes.description: A word inside instructions to visually inspect drug products or note first use.
modes.example: Visually inspect parenteral drug<< products>> for particulate matter and discoloration

card.plain: It fires on the small word just before 'damaged' in warnings not to use a package that has been damaged.
